name: Unity: Powerups
goal: In Darkness Within, the player can aquire powerups which boost the player's stats. Powerups can range from movement speed to attack damage. Since powerups could be added, changed, or removed, they need to be very flexible.

normalLearnings: I can use scriptable objects to create a template and instances using that template
I can call methods based on object / property names / values for flexibility
result: The video below shows the player picking up a movement speed powerup, increasing their speed by 50%.<<video https://www.youtube.com/ember/9fX0grjEXWo>>The picture below shows the PlayerPowerups script, the mothod invokation is solely based on the name of the powerup, allowing for easy addition, altering, and removing of powerup methods.<<image 1.png>>
validation: I validated the feature with fellow teammates, who were enthusiastic about the results.
contribution: This directly contributes to the game. Now I can focus on creating more powerups.
